purpose: Only new visitors on an unhashed directory root enter the approved Physics Explorer; legacy routes remain old app.

operations.afterText:
<script id="qi-default-physics-explorer">
    // A no-hash directory landing selects the approved Physics Explorer.
    // All legacy #/ routes, the explicit index.html page and ?classic=1 remain unchanged.
    (() => {
      if (location.pathname !== '/' && location.pathname !== '/Quantum-index/') return;
      if (location.href.includes('#') || new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('classic') === '1') return;
      const next = new URL('docs/physics-explorer.html', location.href);
      next.search = location.search;
      location.replace(next.href);
    })();
  </script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net" crossorigin>
